ayahs.2: obeying its Rabb as it must,
ayahs.4: ejects its contents and becomes empty,
ayahs.5: obeying its Rabb as it must—
ayahs.6: O humanity, you are labouring restlessly toward your Rabb, and you will meet the consequences of what you did.
ayahs.7: Whoever receives their record in their right hand
ayahs.9: and return to their people joyfully.
ayahs.10: Whoever receives their record from behind their back
ayahs.12: and burn in a blazing Fire.
ayahs.13: They lived carefree among their people,
ayahs.14: thinking they would never return to Allah.
ayahs.15: Yes—they will return. Their Rabb has always been watching them.
ayahs.17: by the night and whatever it gathers in,
ayahs.18: by the moon when it reaches fullness—
ayahs.19: you will pass from stage to stage in life and beyond.
ayahs.20: What is wrong with them that they do not believe,
ayahs.21: and when the Qur'an is recited to them, they do not bow in submission?
ayahs.22: Those who reject the truth persist in denial.
ayahs.23: Allah knows best what they hide.
ayahs.24: So give them news of a painful punishment—
ayahs.25: except those with iman who do good: theirs is a reward that never ends.
